notes.title: Night Project – Chapter 5 IS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Dear players, we proudly present the fifth and final chapter of Night Project! This long-awaited finale will be the culmination of the entire story where all plot threads come together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/5c03ac816522b1af46eff0836c3b4a376a36d0b5.png[/img]

Key features of the chapter:

⚔ Final battle with Kili

The most complex and multi-phase combat in the game

Kili uses all known tactics plus several new ones

Requires application of all previously acquired skills

🔎 Complete plot revelations

The true nature of Degeons Intertaiment experiments

The fate of missing employees and Adrian

Kili's origins and his connection to the protagonist

🏃 Extreme parkour sections

Enhanced movement system

Deadly jumps through destroyed areas

New types of obstacles and traps

Technical improvements:

Added DLSS 3.0 support for maximum smoothness

Completely reworked movement physics

Optimized save system operation

Fixed all critical bugs from previous chapters

Story features:

3 unique endings depending on your choices

Alternative scenes for replay value

Additional documents and recordings revealing story details

"This chapter was a real challenge for our team," says the lead writer. "We tried to make a finale worthy of the whole story, keeping the tension until the last minute."

[previewyoutube=5fDJ0nqHsxY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project – Chapter 4 IS RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Friends, we proudly present the fourth chapter of Night Project – the most psychologically intense part of our story!

What awaits you in the new chapter:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/60936fa8947de0c33abc5c1cf9d4ef7cbcf5c09a.png[/img]

🔹 A living, breathing office
The space literally distorts as you progress. Familiar hallways lead to the unknown, and the walls sometimes... wink. These aren’t glitches – this is your new reality.

🔹 Double threat
Kili has evolved – now there are two of them. The original has become more calculating, while the clone is utterly unpredictable. Their hunting tactics are synchronized – be careful!

🔹 The fate of the missing
Through a series of interactive simulations, you’ll uncover what happened to your colleagues from the first chapter. Each discovery is a new piece of the nightmare’s puzzle.

🔹 Arcade machines for a breather
We’ve added classic ‘90s-style arcade machines for a brief escape from the horrors. But don’t relax too much – Kili never sleeps!

🔹 Enhanced psychological atmosphere
Completely revamped lighting and sound system. Now, every step you take echoes through the office’s twisted space.

"This chapter isn’t just a continuation – it’s a whole new experience," says the lead developer. "We’ve created a world that literally resists your progress."

[previewyoutube=-H42a8c6_Wo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project - Chapter 3 IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Friends, we are thrilled to present the long-awaited Chapter 3 of Night Project! In this chapter, we’ve prepared a host of new experiences that will immerse you in a world of true horror and intense action.

New Locations:
You’ll find yourself on a mysterious street that feels like it’s been ripped from the pages of a gothic novel. Old, moss-covered houses, narrow alleys, dim streetlights, and shadows that seem to have a life of their own. Every corner of this location has been meticulously designed to make you feel trapped in the unknown.

Atmospheric Sound Design:
We’ve paid special attention to the sound design. Now, every step, every creak of a door, or whisper of the wind will make you look over your shoulder. New sound effects create an unparalleled atmosphere of tension that won’t let go until the very end.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/27693fff3e7c4d9b13954eda45ff058d3b701d80.png[/img]

A More Terrifying Kili:
Kili has become even more dangerous and unpredictable. His movements are smoother, and his behavior is more aggressive. Now, he doesn’t just chase you—he plays with you, using the environment to his advantage. You’ll never know where he’ll appear next.

Enhanced Graphics and Animations:
We’ve worked hard to make the visuals even more realistic. Shadows are deeper, lighting is more natural, and character animations are fluid and eerily lifelike.

New Gameplay Mechanics:
In this chapter, we’ve introduced new gameplay elements that will make your experience even more thrilling. You’ll need to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and find ways to survive this nightmare.

Plot Twists:
Chapter 3 will reveal new secrets about the Degeons Intertaiment experiments and show just how far Kili has gone with his plans. Your actions will influence the story, so be ready for surprises!

Don’t miss the chance to dive into the world of Night Project and experience true horror. Chapter 3 is available now, and we’re sure it won’t leave you indifferent. Download, play, and share your impressions!
[previewyoutube=3lJggPAQAWE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project - Chapter 2 RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Night Project Chapter 2 is here!

It’s time to step into a new nightmare! The second chapter of Night Project brings more terrifying challenges and deeper mysteries. This time, your superiors have sent you to the Degeons Intertainment warehouse – but why? They aren’t telling you everything. You’ll have to uncover the truth yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/1c22eeaf10b2ed4d561e4c3d0523423c979245f2.png[/img]
What’s new in this chapter?
	•	New flashlight mechanics – proper use of light is crucial for survival.
	•	New fears and eerie encounters – something is lurking in the warehouse’s shadows.
	•	Notes and tapes – find pieces of the story that reveal Degeons Intertainment’s true nature.
	•	Warehouse exploration – locked rooms, hidden corridors, and unexpected surprises.
	•	Bug fixes for Chapter 1 – improved atmosphere, optimized gameplay, and fixes based on player feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/0a3fc09c406f91a71de6a90825dbdfdb41dd5b60.png[/img]

Your superiors claim this is just a routine task… but what if the truth is far more horrifying than you ever imagined?
[previewyoutube=Ny3I017UJBE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Night Project - Development Progress
notes.notes:
Hi, friends! We want to share fresh updates on the development of Night Project! The process is progressing actively, and now you can track our progress with a special table. It shows the current readiness of each chapter.

At the moment, Chapter 1 is 100% complete – we are fully satisfied with its quality and ready to move forward. Chapter 2 is almost finished – only the final touches remain. Chapter 3 is 60% ready, and we are actively working on its gameplay. Chapters 4 and 5 are still in the early stages, but development is already in full swing!

We want each chapter to be immersive and atmospheric, ensuring that every detail fits the game’s overall vision. This chart will be updated regularly, and we will keep you informed about new developments.

Thank you for staying with us! Your support and excitement motivate us to create something truly special. Stay tuned for more updates![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/d5208c9778742c335c5cb9e758e41796c9dd5cbd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Night Project - Chapter 1 IS OFFICIALLY OUT!
notes.notes:
Friends, this is the moment we've all been waiting for! We are pleased to announce that the first chapter of the Night Project has been released from early access and is now available in the full version on Steam!

After months of hard work, your feedback and testing, we present you a finalized and improved version of the game. The first chapter offers the perfect balance between a dark atmosphere, a fascinating plot and an exciting gameplay.

What's new in the full version?

✅ All early access errors have been fixed — we have taken into account every community comment and improved all aspects of the game. No crashes, no bugs — just the perfect gaming experience!

 New functionality — added unique mechanics that will enrich your interaction with the world of Night Project. Now it has become even more interesting to explore, search and survive.

✅ More Easter eggs and secrets — dive into the depths of the history of the Degeones Intertainment corporation and find the hidden details that make the game world truly alive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/8fb52467954b0b4ff07959b5e44567658c72a658.png[/img]
What's next?

🔥 Multiplayer will be released later. We want to be sure that it will become not just an addition, but a real celebration for fans of the cooperative game. Stay tuned!

Why is it worth playing right now?

Night Project is more than just horror. This is an exciting journey into an atmospheric world where every step, every decision and every found object brings you closer to solving the mystery.
The first chapter begins a story that will stay with you for a long time. Be one of the first to immerse yourself in this unique experience.

💥 JOIN OUR COMMUNITY! 💥
Write reviews, share your findings and help us make the Night Project even better. Your opinion is important to us![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/e7653ff4299ebf4f4a2e68de945a5f9e1df8204e.png[/img]

notes.title: Halloween Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello, players! I am the ghost of Halloween, and I welcome you to the Degeons office. It's especially creepy here today, because everything is decorated for this ominous holiday. But there is also something new: a strange man is waiting for you with a task.

You already know that our office is not only a place of work, but also a real maze full of dangers. And today you have to face one of them — a terrible monster that hides somewhere in dark corners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/985d4e1eb50dd925ed62e94755ae6b37276a9e0a.jpg[/img]
So get ready for an adventure, because something unusual is waiting for you! In the meantime, you can enjoy the Halloween atmosphere that reigns in our office.

What has changed in the office? Here are just some of the innovations:

Atmospheric sounds. Now you can hear ominous rustles, screams and other unusual sounds that create a special Halloween atmosphere.

Halloween decorations. The office is decorated with pumpkins, skeletons, spiders and other attributes of this holiday.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/5fd5dc152c2607e281e86380f525428deddbf445.jpg[/img]
A quest with a monster. You have to go through the maze of the office and fight a terrible monster that hides in dark corners.

Don't miss your chance to test yourself and get new experiences! But be careful, because danger can be waiting for you around every corner.

Good luck, players!

notes.title: Night Project: Demo 1.5 is live!
notes.notes:
We have wonderful news for you! We have updated the Office location, and now it has become even more exciting and exciting.

There are many new interactive items in the office that you can interact with. For example, you can pet a cute cat. Of course, he will not reciprocate, but he will give you unforgettable emotions and joy. You will also be able to explore many new items.

The sounds in the game have also undergone significant changes. Now they have become more frightening and atmospheric, which will add thrills and tension during the passage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45029553/866133eae92e7f0f73b7ed599ab349bbdf6a2def.png[/img]

In addition, we have added new achievements that you can unlock by completing the game. This will be a great incentive for your development and improvement of skills.

And, of course, we did not forget about the visual component. The game has beautiful cutscenes that delight the eye and immerse you in the atmosphere of what is happening.

We have also added new interface elements that will make your interaction with the game world even more convenient and enjoyable. Now you can easily find the right items and complete tasks.

The game has cool features for interacting with the world. For example, you can use new tools to solve puzzles or even create your own items.

We fixed a lot of bugs that prevented you from enjoying the game. The flashlight lighting has been fixed, many texture bugs have been fixed, and new settings items have been added that will allow you to customize the game to your preferences.

Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy all these improvements! The game is waiting for you!
